item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00970","case1_error":"Treats the 12-apple excess as the entire green-apple count, yielding 28 instead of 44 total apples.","case2_error":"Treats payment per page as payment per book, yielding 1800 books instead of 12.","reason":"The first substitutes a difference for a category count; the second confuses per-page and per-book rates.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00971","case1_error":"Leading answer 40 conflicts with the correct derivation and conclusion of 50 mph.","case2_error":"Treats 10 hours over five days as 10 hours per day, producing 3500 instead of 700 pages.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00972","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final value 12000 after the correct expression, which yields 23248.","case2_error":"Uses 10/10 dollars per bead instead of 1/10, producing $1800 instead of $180.","reason":"Case 1 gives an unsupported number after a correct formula; case 2 explicitly writes an incorrect cost relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00973","case1_error":"Adds three inches of probability increments to the 66-inch baseline, although final height exceeds that baseline by only two inches.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final value 80 after correct formulas that yield four weeks.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong baseline for its increase; case 2 states correct relations but supplies an unsupported final number.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00974","case1_error":"Incorrectly replaces 36 × 9 with 432 when evaluating the correct volume expression; the volume is 3888 cubic inches.","case2_error":"Reports the 10 hours needed for additional paintings instead of the requested 16 hours for all paintings.","reason":"Case 1 is a numerical evaluation error; case 2 correctly calculates and reports the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"}]}
